name: Example: Electrical sources
description: Voltage sources set the voltage across their resistor; current sources push their current through it, so the voltmeter reads I · R. A current source drives its current out of its n pin, so with the resistor on p the voltage reads negative. The signal-driven sources follow their input: a 3 V, 50 Hz sine and a constant 0.5 A.
